name: Maximum-Generated Expansion over Complementary Convex Sites
statement: If $S\subseteq B$ are maximum-generated and $B^c=S^c\cap F$ for a coordinate face $F$, then the peripheral expansion $E(B,S)$ is maximum-generated. In particular, when $B$ is the complement of a coordinate face, every nonempty maximum-generated $S\subseteq B$ is allowed without a convexity assumption inside $B$.
proof: Apply convex-site expansion to $S^c$ at the face trace $B^c$, then complement the resulting class and reverse the new height coordinate. Maximum-generated classes are complement closed.
